title: A solution to the quantum Yang--Baxter equation associated with a universal two-valued algebraic group
summary: We construct spectral-parameter solutions of the quantum Yang--Baxter equation from the associativity condition of the universal symmetric $2$-algebraic two-valued group, whose multiplication law depends on four coefficients $k_2,k_4,k_6,k_8$ subject to the single relation $4k_8-k_4^2+k_2k_6=0$ -- which coincides with the three-dimensional WDVV equation for Dubrovin's normalised potential. Every three-dimensional Frobenius manifold with a cyclic vector field carries such a spectral two-valued group, whose finite branch points are the eigenvalues of the multiplication operator. For an…
